notes.title: 1.0 is Finally Here!
notes.content:
What's new:
[list]
[*] Endless Mode
[*] 2 New Events
[*] 2 New Monsters (Bats and Plants)
[*] More Languages (Chinese, Spanish, Italian and Russian)
[*] UI Changes
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]

tags.feature: [*] More Languages (Chinese, Spanish, Italian and Russian)

notes.title: Update 0.9.0.0
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Adding random events instead of normal rounds (there is a chance that an event will be started instead of a normal round)
[*] German has been added as a new language
[*] Modification of boss mechanics
[*] Balancing of skills
[*] Further adjustments to the UI 
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]

tags.feature: [*] Adding random events instead of normal rounds (there is a chance that an event will be started instead of a normal round)
[*] German has been added as a new language

notes.title: Update 0.8.2.0
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Further adjustments to the UI 
[*] Complete customization of all player skills to increase the speed of the game and thus improve the gaming experience
[*] Addition of new perks to create different builds
[*] Addition of new animations
[*] Balancing of skills
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]

[b]Next steps:[/b]
[list]
[*] Adding more perks
[*] Adding Ultimate Perks that you get after every won boss round
[*] Balancing
[*] Bugfixes
[/list]

tags.feature: Complete customization of all player skills to increase the speed of the game and thus improve the gaming experience
Addition of new perks to create different builds

notes.title: Update 0.8.1.0
notes.content:
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] The UI was adjusted to display elements more clearly for the user
[*] The HP of Golems was reduced
[*] HP of Dragons was reduced
[*] HP/Damage of Spiders, Turtles, Skeletons and Evil Mages was adjusted
[*] Monsters appear in a shorter time to increase the game speed
[*] HP/Damage of all bosses was adjusted, because some were too strong/weak
[*] Adjusted abilities of bosses, as certain abilities were too strong/weak
[*] Ability effects of bosses were expanded/adjusted
[*] Player ability effects have been enhanced/adjusted
[*] The ability guide has been adjusted to provide more information
[*] Changes to perks were made to improve balancing
[/list]
